conservation_status.description: "Vulnerable. Found growing in soil in streams and along river banks, rock crevices on cliffs and in sheltered habitats at low altitudes. Rare and often found growing in small quantities in Britain and Ireland. Also known from the Mediterranean islands and region of Europe and north Africa, Caucasus, Azores, Madeira. In North America, occurs in Washington, Oregon, and California USA and British Columbia, Canada." See https://www.inaturalist.org/flags/568164 for rational and discussion of opening the geoprivacy.
